jobs.occupation: Shape Quality for Next-Generation AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose)
We are seeking a QA Manager to help establish and maintain the quality and document-control framework supporting Nordscale’s mission-critical data centre operations. As Nordscale is building its operating organisation, you will have the opportunity to shape practical quality processes, controlled documentation and ways of working from an early stage.

You will ensure that operational and technical information is controlled, traceable, approved, accessible and audit-ready, while helping the organisation identify and implement the quality management arrangements required by applicable customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, the Process Specialist and other technical functions, you will provide quality governance around procedures, records, changes and non-conformities. Technical and operational owners remain accountable for technical content, approvals and corrective work.
What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities)
• Help establish and continuously improve the quality and document-control framework across operations, maintenance, engineering and compliance.
• Manage controlled documents throughout their lifecycle, from creation and approval to publication and archiving.
• Maintain document registers, standards and traceability across controlled information.
• Govern document control for SOPs, MOPs, EOPs and technical work instructions.
• Coordinate audit readiness and ensure relevant evidence and records are available and traceable.
• Define and maintain the requirements and processes for managing non-conformities and corrective actions.
• Ensure operational changes are documented, approved and reflected in controlled documentation.
• Monitor quality and compliance trends to identify areas for improvement.
• Work with Operations and Engineering to embed practical quality controls.About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)
You may come from quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance in data centres, energy, oil and gas, industrial plants, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or another technically complex and audited environment.

You combine strong structure and attention to detail with enough technical understanding to work credibly with engineering and operations teams. You are comfortable helping to build fit-for-purpose quality processes in an organisation that is still developing its systems and ways of working.
Key Characteristics
• Structured and rigorous, with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
• Comfortable challenging gaps in process or evidence while working constructively with operational teams.
• Collaborative and pragmatic, able to translate quality requirements into workable practices.
• Analytical and improvement-oriented, using findings and trends to prevent recurrence.Skills & Qualifications
• Relevant experience in quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance within a technical or regulated environment.
• Strong understanding of document control, revision management, traceability, compliance and audit requirements.
• Experience establishing, implementing or improving practical quality processes and controlled documentation.
• Good digital skills and experience with electronic document or quality management systems.
• Strong interest in exploring and applying LLMs to improve workflows, processes and quality.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik.Nice to Have
• Experience from data centres or other mission-critical infrastructure.
• Experience supporting ISO 9001 or comparable management systems; exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 is also relevant.
• Experience with SOP, MOP and EOP governance in live technical operations.
• Experience from engineering, maintenance or asset-management environments and the handover of as-built, O&M or commissioning documentation.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian.What We Can Offer You
• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
• The opportunity to shape the quality framework and operating standards of a growing AI infrastructure environment.
• A cross-functional role with close exposure to Operations, Engineering and technical specialists.
• Relocation support assessed individually, if required.Equal Opportunities Statement
We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
Application and Contact
Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Build the Future of AI Infrastructure in Northern Norway
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose) 

We are seeking an Operational Process Specialist to strengthen the performance, resilience and continuous improvement of mechanical, electrical and process systems in a mission-critical data centre environment. 

In this role, you will take ownership of operational procedures and help ensure they reflect the technical environment, operational best practice, and the way work is carried out in practice. You will work closely with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to improve processes and support safe, efficient and reliable operations. 

This is an opportunity to help shape the procedures and technical standards behind a growing AI infrastructure environment, with broad exposure across disciplines and a clear impact on day-to-day operations. 

 

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities) 

• Analyse and optimise the performance of mechanical, electrical and process systems. 
• Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, resilience and operational performance. 
• Own the technical and operational content of procedures and support their implementation in day-to-day operations. 
• Develop and improve the technical content of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) and work instructions together with relevant specialists. 
• Collaborate with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to ensure critical infrastructure operates safely, efficiently and within design parameters. 
• Support change management by assessing operational impacts and validating process changes before implementation. 
• Review operational data, completed work, deviations and current practices to identify improvement opportunities. 
• Provide technical input to audits, compliance activities and continuous improvement programmes. 
About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience) 

You may currently be working in technical operations, facilities, maintenance, process improvement or engineering support, with experience from data centres or another technically complex environment such as industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals or manufacturing. 

You have broad technical understanding and enjoy working across disciplines, understanding how systems interact and finding practical ways to improve their operation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline. What matters is that you see the bigger picture, work effectively with technical specialists and take a structured approach to processes, quality and documentation. 

 

Key Characteristics 

• Passionate about operational excellence and continuous improvement. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach. 
• Calm under pressure and able to make informed decisions within mission-critical environments. 
• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. 
• Collaborative and able to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams. 
• Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high operational standards. 
• Safety-focused with a strong understanding of critical infrastructure risk management. 
Skills & Qualifications 

• Relevant experience operating, maintaining or optimising mechanical, electrical or process systems. 
• Broad technical understanding and the ability to see how different systems interact. 
• Experience from technical environments where reliability and operational continuity are critical. 
• Experience developing or improving operational procedures and technical work instructions. 
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
• Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik. 
Nice to Have 

• Experience with SOPs, MOPs, EOPs or similar operational procedures. 
• Experience with process optimisation, continuous improvement or monitoring/BMS systems. 
• Experience from data centres, industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or similar technically complex environments. 
• Relevant technical education or qualifications; equivalent practical experience is also valued. 
What We Can Offer You 

• Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
• Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
• The opportunity to influence operational processes, procedures and technical standards in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure environment. 
• A cross-disciplinary role combining technical understanding, process optimisation and continuous improvement. 
• 
Relocation package if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. 

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. 

 

Application and Contact 

Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Researcher in Mooring Design and Analysis for Offshore Floating Solar Farms
jobs.description:
About the position
A fixed-term 100% researcher position is available at the University of Agder, Faculty of Engineering and Science as a Researcher in Structural Engineering, affiliated to the Department of Engineering Sciences, for a period of 2 years. The position is located at Campus Grimstad.  The starting date is Spring 2027. 

The Department of Engineering Sciences has more than 90 employees in scientific positions, and more than 1500 students at all levels. A variety of research is conducted within all the groups; Mechatronics, Renewable Energy, Civil Engineering and Industrial Economy, and we also welcome interdisciplinary projects within the department or with other research groups. This position will be associated with the Civil Engineering section. We have a broad international cooperation, and close collaboration with industrial partners and public services in the region. This is a benefit both for teaching and research. The partners contribute with assignments, competence and resources.Project Background

As one of the projects successfully funded by the CETPartnership, HelioSea aims to develop and demonstrate an innovative floating photovoltaic (FPV) concept for marine environments. The technology integrates a tension-leg platform, dual-axis solar tracking, and intelligent operational control. Through the design, deployment, and monitored operation of a pilot system, the project aims to advance the concept from Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3 to TRL 5.
Responsibilities
The researcher will contribute to the work package focused on advancing offshore solar farms. The work package involves five project partners and includes the following tasks:

• Numerical modelling of shared mooring configurations;
• Wave-basin testing of FPV farms;
• Analysis of FPV farms co-located with floating breakwaters; and
• Assessment of farm-level energy production and power performance.
The focus of this position will be the design of shared mooring and cable layouts. The researcher may also support experimental testing and pilot activities. The work will include dynamic response analyses, covering both hydrodynamic and aerodynamic effects, as well as structural integrity analyses.

The researcher will collaborate closely with project partners, including partners from Spain and Portugal, to carry out the project activities. The research will involve preparing and submitting project reports and high-quality scientific publications, as well as contributing to dissemination activities at the European level.
Required qualifications
• A PhD in marine technology, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, or another relevant field. Applicants must have had their doctoral thesis approved by the application deadline.
• Expertise in at least one of the following areas: Fluid dynamics; Design of marine structures; Offshore multibody structures; Multiphysics simulation of marine and offshore structures; Experimental analysis of marine structure.Desired qualifications
• A strong record of high-quality scientific publications;
• Strong programming and analytical skills; and
• Experience working collaboratively in international research projects.
Emphasis will be placed upon the project description and the relevance it has with regard to the subject in question and the research environment at the Faculty. 

Personal qualities and suitability for the position will be emphasised.
We offer
• professional development in a large, exciting and socially influential organisation 
• a positive, inclusive and diverse working environment 
• modern facilities and a comprehensive set of welfare offers  
• membership of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
More about working at UiA.

The position is remunerated according to the State Salary Scale, salary plan 17.510, code 1109, NOK 680 000 – 730 000,- gross salary per year. Higher salary grades may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. A compulsory pension contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund is deducted from the pay according to current statutory provisions.
General information
UiA is an open and inclusive university. We believe that diversity enriches the UiA is an open and inclusive university. We believe that diversity enriches the workplace and makes us better. We, therefore, encourage qualified candidates to apply for the position independent of gender, age, cultural background, disability or an incomplete CV. The successful applicant will have rights and obligations in accordance with the current regulations for the position, and organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities of the position must be expected. The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning the acts relating to Control of Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Appointment is made by the University of Agder’s Appointments Committee for Teaching and Research Positions.  

A background check may be conducted to verify information that appears in available documents. Background checks are always done with the applicant's consent, and employment in the position requires an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information. 

Short-listed applicants will be invited for interviews and a demonstration of their teaching competency, usually in the form of a trial lecture. With permission from the applicant the university also will conduct a reference check before appointment. The final recommendation will be an overall assessment based on the expert assessment, the trial lecture, the interview(s) and references. Read more about the employment process.  

In accordance with the Freedom of Information Act § 25 (2), applicants may request that they are not identified in the open list of applicants. The University, however, reserves the right to publish the names of applicants. Applicants will be advised of the University’s intention to exercise this right.
Application
The application and any necessary information about education and experience (including diplomas and certificates) are to be sent electronically. Use the link "Apply for this job".

The following documentation must be uploaded electronically: 

• Transcripts from PhD, master, and bachelor studies with grades
• CV with detailed education and work experience
• Up to 10 academic articles and R&D projects which the candidate wishes to particularly emphasise for the assessment process 
• A brief project description on the topic of mooring design for FPV array (max 2 pages)

The applicant is fully responsible for submitting complete digital documentation before the closing date. All documentation must be available in a Scandinavian language or English. 

Application deadline: 10.01.27.

jobs.occupation: Partnership Manager
jobs.description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns our partners into a steady source of new customers.

The role in short
We have 3 to 5 prospective partners who could bring us customers. Today we don't work with them in a structured way. You change that. You own every partner relationship, build the method for how we work together, and make things happen.

You also measure it. You build the reporting that shows what each partner brings in. When the data shows a partner sends us the right customers, you double down.

What you'll do
• 
Own the relationship with every prospective partner, from the first conversation to a partnership that delivers.

• 
Build our partnership methodology: how we choose partners, work with them and follow up. There isn't one yet.

• 
Set up reporting on the results of the partnership motion, and share it with the team.

• 
Use the data to double down on the partners that bring in ICP opportunities.

• 
Create the content partners need to recommend and sell Amanda.

• 
Keep Aiba top of mind with every partner, so we're the first name they think of.

• 
Run partner events and joint activities that keep the relationships active.

• 
Work closely with sales and marketing, and hand warm opportunities to our Account Executives.

Who you are
• 
You have 2 to 3 years of experience in partnerships.

• 
You can turn a friendly intro into a partnership with real results.

• 
You like numbers. You'd rather show what a partner delivers than talk about it.

• 
You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers in hoodies.

• 
You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

• 
You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

• 
Your English is great, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for
If you want a partner program that's already built, with a playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here.

What you get
• 
Starting at NOK 750,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

• 
Commission on two things: how partnerships convert into business, and partner engagement, like the partner events you run

• 
Real impact. You build the partner channel from scratch, and in a team this size, it visibly moves the company.

• 
A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

• 
A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

• 
Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

How to apply
Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

This is one of three commercial roles Aiba is hiring for right now. The other two, Account Executive and Sales Development Representative, are on The Hub too.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content.

Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis.

Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience.

Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time.

Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language.

By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

jobs.occupation: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns that interest into real sales conversations.

The role in short
You own the Education stage of our pipeline. Leads come in curious but cold. You warm them up, show them why Amanda fits their community, and turn the right ones into real opportunities for our Account Executives. You work from a set list of clearly defined ICP customers, so you always know where to spend your time.

Most of our pipeline starts at events. Before a conference, you fill the calendars of our management and sales team with the right meetings. Before a community dinner, you make sure the right people have a seat at the table. Afterwards, you follow up until a good conversation becomes a customer.

What you'll do
• 
Nurture and warm up leads in the Education stage, and convert them into opportunities in the sales pipeline.

• 
Work from a set list of clearly defined ICP customers. You'll know exactly who they are and why Amanda fits them.

• 
Own our most important source of pipeline: events, conferences and community dinners around the world.

• 
Book sales meetings for management and the sales team before every event.

• 
Fill our community dinners with the right people.

• 
Follow up after every event, so meetings and dinners turn into customers over time.

• 
Work closely with our community director, and help create the marketing content that brings leads in.

• 
Pick up the phone. Some outbound cold calling is part of the job, but it isn't the whole job.

Who you are
• 
You have 1 to 2 years of experience as an SDR.

• 
You love organizing. A packed event calendar with zero double bookings is a good week for you.

• 
You write well, and you're comfortable on the phone.

• 
You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers.

• 
You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

• 
You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

• 
Your English is greatexcellent, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for
If you want a pure cold-calling job, this isn't it. If you want a finished playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here either.

What you get
• 
Starting at NOK 600,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

• 
Commission on two things: how many of your sales-accepted leads become sales-qualified (SAL to SQL), and the ARR you and your AE pod sell each quarter

• 
Real impact. In a team this size, the pipeline you build visibly moves the company.

• 
A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

• 
A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

• 
Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

How to apply
Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

This is one of three commercial roles Aiba is hiring for right now. The other two, Account Executive and Partnership Manager, are on The Hub too.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content.

Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis.

Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience.

Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time.

Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language.

By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

jobs.occupation: Electrical Shift Technician
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose)
Join our operations team at the Kvandal facility outside Narvik, where you will help keep the systems supporting our data centres running safely and reliably. The facility operates 24/7, and you will be part of a team working continuous shifts to ensure reliable operations around the clock.

We are building a larger operations team and will be hiring several shift technicians across different levels of experience. Whether you are newly qualified and looking to build your experience alongside experienced colleagues, or already have operational experience and are ready to work more independently with maintenance and troubleshooting, we would like to hear from you. Previous operational experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
What You Will Do
If you are early in your career:

• Assist in the operation and maintenance of electrical equipment such as switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators and batteries
• Perform rounds and inspections, and report deviations
• Respond to alarms using BMS systems and follow approved procedures
• Keep clear logs and maintenance records
• Learn from and support colleagues, including during major maintenance work
• Work safely, follow our safety rules, and report hazards and incidents
 

If you have more experience, the role will additionally involve:

• Operating and maintaining electrical equipment, including high-voltage installations and switchgear
• Performing planned, preventative, predictive and corrective maintenance, inspections and condition monitoring
• Troubleshooting electrical faults and escalating the most complex issues to our technical specialists
• Participating in commissioning, energisation and testing as the facility grows
• Collaborating with contractors and grid operators, including during major maintenance windows
• Following electrical safety rules and permit to work routinesWho We Think You Are
If you are early in your career or have limited previous experience:

• Trade certificate (Fagbrev) as an electrician, or equivalent relevant vocational qualification
• Proficient in English, as it is our company language
• Motivated to learn and develop within a 24/7 operational environment 
If you have more experience:

• Previous operations experience from industry, energy, maritime or other 24/7 environments
• Strong electrical fault-finding skills and the ability to interpret single-line diagrams
• Experience working independently with electrical operations and maintenanceIt is desirable, but not a requirement, that you have:
• Data centre experience
• Knowledge of transformers, switchgear, UPS systems or generators, or of Schneider, Eaton or ABB systems
• Knowledge of NEK 400
• Knowledge of a Scandinavian languagePersonal Qualities
You are practically minded, eager to learn, and have a strong HSE mindset. You take accountability for your tasks and collaborate well with others. If you have more experience, we also expect you to prioritise effectively in a demanding operational environment and communicate clearly with colleagues and other technical disciplines. You are comfortable using digital tools for documentation, logging and reporting.

 
What We Can Offer
• Competitive salary and good terms
• A secure, long-term position in a growing industry
• Training and development opportunities
• A safe, inclusive and supportive working environment
At Nordscale, you get the opportunity to develop further. If you show that you take ownership and build your competence, you can over time move into a more independent role with greater responsibility.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 60 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

What are we looking for

We are seeking an Oslo-based, experienced and highly organised person to support the Executive Director and Board Chair. The successful candidate will have strong interpersonal and organisational skills and exercise discretion and confidentiality when handling correspondence and other sensitive information.The role requires excellent time management and the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail. A proactive approach to problem-solving, a willingness to take on a variety of responsibilities and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment are essential. The role will report to the Executive Director. 

Duties and responsibilities
• Coordinate travel authorisations and confirm budget availability in line with relevant policies.
• Plan missions with country teams, including travel bookings, visa applications, itineraries and transport.
• Arrange meetings and compile materials needed for travel and missions.
• Prepare travel claims and track expenses in accordance with relevant policies.
• Monitor the Executive Director’s and Board Chair’s inboxes and urgent messages, draft approved correspondence and follow up with staff and EITI stakeholders.
• Ensure the Executive Director’s leave and working hours are accurately recorded.
• Maintain and archive the Senior Management Team’s agenda items, and coordinate meeting agendas in line with internal policies.
• Support engagement with the supporting countries constituency by scheduling meetings and liaising with the Finance Manager on reporting and budget queries.
• Schedule Senior Management Team meetings, invite relevant colleagues and record and communicate decisions and action points.
• Coordinate Senior Management Team activities, including assistance in organising retreats and the coordination of leave schedules.
• Provide targeted administrative support across the Secretariat, including assisting the Operations team when needed and helping to coordinate internal events, recognising the close links between the team’s work and support for the Executive Director and Board Chair.Qualifications
Required:

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration or similar.
• Minimum 3 years’ experience as an executive assistant or office administrative assistant.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and digital finance/travel systems.
• Demonstrated ability to learn new digital systems quickly.
• Working knowledge of data management and data protection (GDPR) principles.
Desirable:

• Experience working in an international environment and with international organisations.
• Working knowledge of French and Spanish.  We can offer
This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change. 

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, attractive benefits and an above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests a range of NOK 560,000 to NOK 580,000. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

This is an Oslo-based role. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in Norway and hold any required work permit before starting the position. Relocation support is not provided.Email applications will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) is the global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources.

Guided by the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the EITI has established a global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources. The EITI Standard requires the disclosure of information along the extractive industry value chain from the point of extraction, to how revenues make their way through the government, and how they benefit the public. By doing so, the EITI seeks to strengthen public and corporate governance, promote understanding of natural resource management, and provide the data to inform reforms for greater transparency and accountability in the extractives sector. In each of the 55 implementing countries, the EITI is supported by a coalition of government, companies, and civil society.

The EITI is committed to achieving diversity in terms of gender, nationality, culture and educational background. The EITI is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.occupation: Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Fossefall is building the infrastructure needed to power Europe's AI future. As our GPU and AI data centre projects move from design and procurement into construction, testing and operational readiness, we need a Commissioning Manager who can turn our commissioning strategy into a coordinated, evidence-based delivery plan.

Reporting to the VP Commissioning, you will lead owner-side project commissioning from design review and factory testing through installation verification, start-up, integrated systems testing and handover. You will connect engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery, identify gaps early and provide clear recommendations on readiness and acceptance. The role is based in Oslo with a hybrid working model and regular travel to project sites and supplier facilities.
What you'll do
• 
Develop and maintain the project Commissioning Plan, scope, schedule, resource plan and readiness gates, integrated with construction, utility availability and phased delivery.

• 
Review designs and supplier documentation for testability, maintainability and operational requirements.

• 
Coordinate the full L1-L5 commissioning process: factory testing, installation QA/QC and static tests, start-up and pre-functional checks, system or module SAT and integrated systems testing.

• 
Review and coordinate test method statements, scripts, load profiles, acceptance criteria, sequences of operation and cause-and-effect coverage with engineering SMEs, contractors, OEMs and the independent Commissioning Authority where appointed.

• 
Secure test prerequisites, including permanent or temporary power, load banks, thermal loads, cooling readiness, water quality, calibrated instruments, controls connectivity and safe working arrangements.

• 
Coordinate electrical, mechanical and liquid-cooling systems, BMS, EPMS and DCIM, fire and life safety, security and ICT/OT interfaces. Align facility readiness with rack, server, cluster and platform delivery leads.

• 
Use Omega365 as the system of record for commissioning scope, checklists, test evidence, digital sign-off, punch and NCR status, retests and readiness reporting.

• 
Manage commissioning risks, blockers, changes and deferred tests. Escalate failed acceptance criteria and readiness gaps with clear evidence and recommended actions.

• 
Prepare readiness recommendations, including RFC before L4, RFS following successful integrated systems testing and RFT after the agreed IT and service-validation scope.

• 
Coordinate Operations training, O&M deliverables, handover, the final commissioning report and the outstanding-item register.
About you
• 
Typically 5+ years of experience in commissioning or delivery of complex technical facilities, including responsibility for multidisciplinary commissioning.

• 
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Energy Systems or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience from commissioning complex technical facilities may compensate for formal education.

• 
Strong working knowledge of power and cooling infrastructure, controls integration, functional testing, failure scenarios and integrated systems testing.

• 
Experience leading contractors, OEMs and specialist test teams through clear plans, responsibilities, decisions and escalation, including teams without a direct reporting line.

• 
The judgement to challenge test methods, assess evidence, manage cross-discipline interfaces and make clear recommendations on system readiness.

• 
A structured, pragmatic and decisive working style. You communicate technical risks clearly and follow issues through to verified closure.

• 
Fluent professional English, both written and spoken, and willingness to travel and work on site during critical testing periods.

• 
Experience from owner-side commissioning in data centres or other mission-critical environments, modular facilities, GPU or AI infrastructure, liquid cooling or first-of-kind systems would be valuable. So would experience with Omega365 or comparable digital commissioning tools, Norwegian or another Scandinavian language and a relevant commissioning or project management certification, but none of these is required.
What success looks like
Within the first few months, project commissioning is governed by a clear and trusted plan, testing is prepared before site execution and readiness decisions are supported by complete, traceable evidence. Engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery understand their responsibilities and interfaces. Risks are surfaced early, defects and deferred tests are controlled and handover is completed without avoidable gaps between facility readiness and technology deployment.
Why Fossefall?
This is an opportunity to shape owner-side commissioning capability while Fossefall's AI infrastructure portfolio is being built. You will work across the physical and digital layers of high-performance AI facilities, influence how projects move from construction into reliable operation and collaborate with specialists across engineering, project delivery, operations and technology.

We are still small enough for individual judgement and ownership to matter. You will have room to improve how we work, contribute to critical delivery decisions and help build repeatable commissioning practices for future projects.
About Fossefall
Fossefall is a Nordic AI infrastructure company founded in 2025. We develop and operate AI factories powered by renewable energy, turning clean Nordic power into scalable, sovereign computing capacity for Europe, built in partnership with local communities, energy producers and technology leaders across the world. As a team, we are still small enough to know each other as people, and our culture is shaped by ownership, curiosity, warmth and collaboration.
Interested?
Make sure your CV is up to date for this role and tell us briefly why this opportunity is interesting to you and how your experience connects to what we are looking for. We review applications as they come in and keep the role open until we find the right colleague. Due to the nature of our business, background checks and/or security clearance may be required as part of the employment process.

Som Business Operations & Claims Specialist blir du en del av den lokale salgsorganisasjonen i Norge. Du vil støtte økonomisk administrasjon og operative prosesser som bidrar til at virksomheten og forhandlernettverket fungerer godt.

I tett samarbeid med forhandlere, salg, marked, økonomi, leverandører og hovedkontoret vil du bidra til korrekt registrering, oppfølging til rett tid og effektive arbeidsprosesser.

Hovedansvarsområder

Forhandlerkrav, bonuser og salgsinsentiver – fra et salgsperspektiv

•	Administrere og følge opp forhandlerkrav, bonusordninger og salgsinsentiver i tråd med gjeldende retningslinjer.

•	Kontrollere krav mot vilkårene for ordningene, underlagsdokumentasjon og salgsdata, samt koordinere godkjenninger med relevante interessenter og hovedkontoret.

•	Følge opp manglende dokumentasjon, avvik og unntak med forhandlere og interne team.

•	Holde oversikt over innsendte, behandlede og utestående krav, og sørge for korrekt registrering og avklaring innen rimelig tid.

•	Være kontaktperson for forhandlere i spørsmål om krav, bonusordninger og salgsinsentiver.

•	Utarbeide rapporter om krav og insentiver for salgsteamet.

•	Bidra til korrekt salgsrapportering ved å kontrollere relevante data og følge opp avvik.

Innkjøp og koordinering av leverandørfakturaer

•	Koordinere lokale innkjøpsforespørsler og innkjøpsordrer, inkludert opprettelse og oppfølging, og gi Finance Business Partner informasjon om utestående forpliktelser ved behov.

•	Støtte registrering av nye leverandører, vedlikehold av leverandørdata og innkjøpsadministrasjon i samarbeid med hovedkontoret.

•	Koordinere leverandøravtaler og kontraktsdokumentasjon i tråd med hovedkontorets innkjøpspolicy og krav til godkjenning.

Lokal driftsstøtte og administrasjon

•	Vedlikeholde korrekte kundedata.

•	Støtte administrasjonen av kunde-, garanti- og kommersielle krav i samarbeid med hovedkontoret.

•	Koordinere daglige administrative oppgaver for den lokale organisasjonen, inkludert kontorlokaler, leieavtaler, strøm og andre felleskostnader, telekommunikasjon og andre driftsbehov.

•	Koordinere lokale driftsleverandører, kontrakter, serviceavtaler og fornyelser.

•	Være et lokalt administrativt kontaktpunkt for leverandører og interne interessenter, og bidra til å løse daglige spørsmål.

Virksomhetsstøtte og prosessforbedring

•	Støtte Finance Business Partner og samarbeide med økonomiavdelingen ved hovedkontoret og andre relevante team om operative økonomiske og administrative spørsmål.

•	Støtte Finance Business Partner og relevante interessenter ved revisjoner og etterlevelseskontroller ved å fremskaffe operativ dokumentasjon og relevante opplysninger.

•	Identifisere og formidle muligheter for å forbedre arbeidsprosesser og dokumentasjon knyttet til krav, insentiver, fakturering og administrasjon.

Kvalifikasjoner

•	Bachelorgrad i økonomi, administrasjon eller et beslektet fagområde, eller relevant yrkesrettet utdanning, er en fordel. Relevant arbeidserfaring kan veie opp for manglende formelle kvalifikasjoner.

•	2–3 års arbeidserfaring eller mer.

•	Erfaring fra administrasjon, salgsstøtte, fakturering, kravbehandling eller en lignende koordinerende rolle.

•	Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter og evne til å arbeide nøyaktig.

•	Komfortabel med å arbeide med tall, registreringer og regneark, inkludert grunnleggende bruk av Excel.

•	Evne til å følge rutiner, håndtere flere oppgaver og overholde frister.

•	Gode kommunikasjonsevner og en serviceinnstilt tilnærming i samarbeid med kolleger, forhandlere og leverandører.

•	Vilje til å lære nye systemer og prosesser, og til å stille spørsmål ved behov.

•	Erfaring med forhandlernettverk, bilbransjen, krav eller insentivordninger er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

•	Norsk- og engelskkunnskaper som er tilstrekkelige for å kommunisere med lokale forhandlere og internasjonale kolleger.

About ZEEKR

ZEEKR is a premium electric mobility brand within Geely Holding Group, combining advanced technology with Scandinavian design. As we continue to develop our business in Norway through a dealer model, we are looking for a Business Operations & Claims Specialist to support our local sales organisation.

The Role

As Business Operations & Claims Specialist, you will be part of the local sales organisation in Norway, supporting the financial administration and operational processes that enable the business and dealer network to run smoothly.

You will coordinate dealer claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives, follow up on invoices and payments, and support procurement and local administrative activities. Working closely with dealers, Sales, Marketing, Finance, suppliers and HQ, you will help ensure accurate records, timely follow-up and effective ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

Dealer Claims, Bonuses & Sales Incentives from a Sales perspective 

•	Administer and follow up on dealer claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives in accordance with applicable guidelines.

•	Review claims against scheme terms, supporting documentation and sales data, and coordinate approvals with relevant stakeholders and HQ.

•	Follow up on missing documentation, discrepancies and exceptions with dealers and internal teams.

•	Track submitted, processed and outstanding claims, ensuring accurate records and timely resolution.

•	Act as a point of contact for dealers on claims, bonus schemes and sales incentives.

•	Prepare claims and incentive reports for the Sales team.

•	Support accurate sales reporting by checking relevant data and following up on discrepancies.

Procurement & Supplier Invoice Coordination

•	Coordinate local purchase requests and purchase orders, including creation and tracking, and provide information on outstanding commitments to the Finance Business Partner as needed

•	Support vendor onboarding, supplier master data and procurement administration in coordination with HQ.

•	Coordinate supplier agreements and contract documentation in line with HQ procurement policies and approval requirements.

Local Operations & Administrative Support

•	Maintain accurate customer master data.

•	Support the administration of customer, warranty and commercial claims in coordination with HQ.

•	Coordinate day-to-day administration for the local organisation, including office facilities, leases, utilities, telecommunications and other operational needs.

•	Coordinate local operational suppliers, contracts, service agreements and renewals.

•	Act as a local administrative point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, helping resolve day-to-day issues.

Business Support & Process Improvements

•	Support the Finance Business Partner and coordinate with HQ Finance and other relevant teams on operational financial and administrative matters.

•	Support the Finance Business Partner and relevant stakeholders during audits and compliance reviews by providing operational documentation and records.

•	Identify and communicate opportunities to improve operational processes and documentation related to claims, incentives, invoicing and administration.

Qualifications

•	Bsc. degree in business administration, finance or a related field or relevant vocational training is an advantage. Relevant work experience may be considered instead of formal qualifications.

•	2-3+ years of work experience.

•	Experience in administration, sales support, invoicing, claims handling or a similar coordination role. 

•	Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

•	Comfortable working with numbers, records and spreadsheets, including basic Excel.

•	Ability to follow procedures, manage several tasks and meet deadlines.

•	Clear communication skills and a service-minded approach when working with colleagues, dealers and suppliers.

•	Willingness to learn new systems and processes and ask questions when needed.

•	Experience with dealer networks, automotive businesses, claims or incentive schemes is an advantage, but not required.

•	Norwegian and English language skills appropriate for communicating with local dealers and international colleagues.

Please submit your CV in English 

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Head of Legal
jobs.description:
We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.

When you join Tibber, you'll help shape how an entire industry gets reimagined – from how we reach new customers, to how we build a brand that hundreds of thousands of people trust with something as fundamental as their energy. You'll be part of a real shift in how people consume electricity – good for our users, their wallets and the planet.

We’re looking for a Head of Legal to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?

Job Mission 🚀

As Head of Legal you will be a calm, hands-on partner to the business, with a small team and close contact with the leadership team and the CFO. You cover contracts, corporate law, employment and consumer law, regulatory matters and privacy across four countries, and you help us take our governance one step further.

What you'll do ✅

• 
Advise on and negotiate our larger agreements, and set practical standards and templates.

• 
Run corporate law and governance across the group, including the role of Secretary to the Board.

• 
Cover consumer law, employment law and product liability for our hardware.

• 
Support compliance in a regulated industry, including the permits and licenses we need. 

• 
Lead on privacy together with our Data Protection Officer, including data incidents.

• 
Make legal work easier for the business: clear guidance, self-service and tools built with AI.

• 
Work efficiently with external counsel, and lead a small team.

What we're looking for⚡

• 
A lawyer (Master of Laws or equivalent) with 8+ years of experience, including several years in a senior or leading role, in-house or from a leading firm. You have advised executives and boards.

• 
Experienced in Nordic corporate law. Norwegian company law is a plus.

• 
Broad across contracts, corporate law, employment and consumer law, and privacy.

• 
Pragmatic and hands-on, with integrity in difficult questions.

• 
Curious about using AI in legal work.

• 
Fluent in English. Norwegian or Swedish is an advantage.

The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️

Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.

Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done - and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.

Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started.

Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition? Apply below!

jobs.occupation: Product Engineer - R&D - Construction
jobs.description:
Be the bridge between Norwegian municipalities and a team that builds with AI every day.

As part of the departmentWe are building software that powers the entire construction lifecycle from first sketch to final handover. Our solutions lead the Nordic market, and we're trusted by companies across the region to keep their projects running smoothly.

We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our team in Tønsberg with 5+ years of technical experience in software development and a good understanding of construction products, you can bring a customer and domain perspective to the way we build and test our software. The team is both developing and maintaining the ByggSøk application – a modern, cloud-based solution that simplifies and streamlines the entire building permit process for professionals in the construction industry, from planning to submission and communication with municipalities. We deliver about 50% of all digital building permit applications submitted to local authorities in Norway.

This is a product-focused role in a team that is increasingly built around AI. You will spend more of your time working with AI tools and agents than writing code by hand: turning domain knowledge and customer needs into well-defined solutions, directing AI to build, test and document them, and making sure what we deliver is correct, secure and actually useful for our users. You will be the person who knows ByggSøk and the Norwegian building permit domain inside out, and who speaks with our Norwegian customers, municipalities and stakeholders on the team's behalf.

The team is continuously improving collaboration, automation and integrations between professionals, municipalities and national services – helping shape the future of digital building permit solutions in Norway. The team runs on Scrum and uses Jira, Confluence, GitHub and Claude Code.

Your primary workplace will be in Tønsberg, where you'll collaborate with your immediate team, though we offer flexibility for remote work when appropriate. We place high value on collaboration, and you'll be working alongside talented professionals at all levels, both locally and globally.

Your role:

• 
Own the understanding of ByggSøk – its functionality, users, regulations and integrations – and act as the link between customers, municipalities, business and the development team.

• 
Shape the product: gather and clarify needs, write and refine requirements and user stories, and help prioritise the backlog.

• 
Use AI tools and agents (such as Claude Code and Copilot) to prototype, implement, test, analyse and document solutions, and review and quality-assure what they produce.

• 
Continuously find new ways to apply AI to make the team, the product and our customers' workflow more efficient.

• 
Participate in Norwegian-language meetings, workshops and customer dialogue, and communicate clearly with the international team in English.

• 
Work closely with developers and testers in Scrum, contributing to code and technical decisions where it makes sense.

What you bring:

• 
Fluent Norwegian, ideally native level, both written and spoken – this is a must, as you will lead and attend meetings and talk with Norwegian customers and authorities daily

• 
Good English communication skills, both written and verbal

• 
Available to work on site in Tønsberg

• 
Hands-on experience using AI tools in daily work, and a curiosity and drive to explore what they can do

• 
5+ years of technical experience in software development.

• 
Strong ability to learn and understand project details and domain knowledge – experience from the construction industry, public sector, building permits (byggesak) or similar regulated domains is a strong advantage

• 
Experience from product, solution, business analysis, consulting or software roles, working in an agile team

• 
Technical understanding of modern web solutions – a background as a developer or experience with .NET, Angular/TypeScript or SQL is an advantage, but deep coding skills are not required

• 
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub is an advantage

• 
A structured, curious and responsible way of working, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people

Why join EG?We hire ambitious and curious people who want to make an impact. Here, you’ll work with leading technology and real industry challenges, with the opportunity to learn and grow alongside talented colleagues. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and the freedom to take ownership, while being part of a global community where we collaborate and grow across teams, functions and borders.We look forward to hearing from you! If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Szymon Graczyk, Team Manager on sgrac@eg.dk. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and hire when the right candidate is found. So please send your CV and application as soon as possible, using the apply button in the job ad. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

At EG, we build software that makes a difference.Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day, from doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer and more efficient projects. Built by people who understand the industries we serve and backed by EG’s scale, our software keeps key processes running smoothly, so people can focus on what matters.

Join us in creating software that works for people, not software that makes people work.

Visit our career pages to meet some of your future colleagues, explore our culture, and watch our video "We Make a Difference".

jobs.description:
Aviant delivers food and medicine to people's gardens using drones. After starting in the labs at MIT in 2020, we have flown over 10,000 flights, covered tens of thousands of kilometers and currently operate the largest commercial base for last-mile drone delivery in Europe, at Ski just outside Oslo. Demand is growing faster than our fleet, and we now need to build a lot more drones. We are therefore looking for hands-on Drone Builders / Drone Mechanics to join our workshop and help us scale up production.

As a Drone Builder, you will:

• 
Build and assemble new drones, from components to flight-ready aircraft

• 
Wire, solder and crimp harnesses, connectors and power systems

• 
Install and test motors, servos, batteries, flight controllers and other electronics

• 
Do composite work, repairs and replacement of airframe parts

• 
Run bench tests and quality checks before handing drones over to flight operations

• 
Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on our operational fleet

• 
Follow and improve build instructions, checklists and documentation, so every drone is built the same way, every time

• 
Find smarter ways to build faster with higher quality (jigs, fixtures, kits, 3D-printed parts)

Relevant technology:

• 
Aircraft type: Fixed-wing VTOL, 2.5m wingspan

• 
Methods: Soldering, crimping, 3D printing, CNC, metalworking

• 
Materials: Composites (CFRP, GFRP), wood, metal, plastic

• 
Components: BLDC motors, servos, lithium batteries, flight controllers, PCBs

• 
Tools: Multimeter, hand and power tools, technical drawings and CAD

Ideal candidate:

• 
Loves to work with your hands and takes pride in doing things properly

• 
Extremely structured and detail-oriented. In aviation, small mistakes matter

• 
Has practical experience from building or repairing things, such as drones, RC aircraft, cars, bikes, electronics or aircraft

• 
Is comfortable with soldering and basic electronics

• 
Hungry for results and motivated by seeing your work fly

It's a plus if you have:

• 
A trade certificate (fagbrev) or education as e.g. aircraft technician, electrician, automation technician or industrial mechanic

• 
Experience with composites, 3D printing or series production

• 
Experience from aviation maintenance or other quality-controlled production

No drone experience is required. You will be trained in Aviant's build and maintenance procedures.

What we offer:

• 
Work on introducing a new means of transportation into society. Like building the first cars, you can tell your grandkids that "I was part of making this happen"

• 
See the drones you build fly real deliveries to customers every week

• 
Work in the leading environment in Europe for these systems

• 
Large stock option package. When we succeed, we all succeed!

Practical:

• 
Position: 100%, on-site

• 
Start: As soon as possible

• 
Location: Ski, Norway (10 min train from Oslo)

• 
Language: Norwegian or English

• 
Process: A short first interview, followed by a practical hands-on test in our workshop

• 
We review applications continuously and hire as soon as we find the right people, so apply early!

If you want to build the drones that make drone delivery a reality, please apply!

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Reliability Science for AI-Enabled Systems
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
We are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our research activities in reliability science for AI-enabled systems.

The PhD project will focus on developing methods to understand, assess, and improve the reliability and trustworthiness of AI-enabled systems. The research will address challenges arising when AI becomes an integral part of systems where failures or incorrect decisions may have significant operational, economic, environmental, or safety consequences.

The candidate will work in an interdisciplinary research environment combining reliability engineering, artificial intelligence, prognostics and health management, and industrial decision support. The position offers opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners and for participation in international research activities.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

You will be supervised by Professor Janet Lin.
Duties of the position
• Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination
• Participate in the RAMS research group (RAMS - MTP - NTNU)
• Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
• Collaborate with academic and industrial partners when relevant.
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
• You must have a relevant Master's degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, computer science, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
• Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
• You must have good written and oral English language and communication skills
• You must have a documented academic background in at least one area relevant, such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, reliability engineering, prognostics and health management, data analytics, automation and control, or related methods
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Knowledge of or experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning methods.
• Knowledge of reliability engineering, prognostics and health management (PHM), condition monitoring, maintenance, or safety-critical systems.
• Experience with programming, data analysis, modelling, or simulation using relevant tools and languages.
• Experience with research-oriented work, for example through a Master's thesis, scientific publications, research projects, or other relevant research activities.
• Experience with industrial applications or interdisciplinary research involving engineering and artificial intelligence is an advantage.
• Knowledge of or interest in topics related to trustworthy AI, such as uncertainty, robustness, explainability, verification and validation, or AI safety, is an advantagePersonal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Work independently and take responsibility for progressing your research
• Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
• Show curiosity, creativity, and strong motivation for the research area
• Analyze complex problems, assess different perspectives, and draw well-founded conclusions
• Communicate and collaborate effectively with researchers and other relevant partners
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Working capital that can be used to implement the project
• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees

About the position / About the job
Applications are invited for a 4-year position as postdoctoral researcher in epigenetics and obesity research at the newly established K.G Jebsen Centre of Obesity ReseArch (CORA).

The position will be affiliated to Anita Göndör’s research group at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at Institute of Clinical Medicine, UiO, physically located at Campus Ahus (Akershus University Hospital) (https://www.med.uio.no/klinmed/english/people/aca/anitagon/)

The project aims at exploring novel, transcriptional and post-transcriptional mechanisms of gene regulation that govern adipose stem cell properties, preadipocyte expansion and differentiation for lipid storage in physiological and pathological conditions. 

 

 
 
The applicant will analyze the role of 3D genome organization in the regulation of human body weight and adipose tissue biology in general. Specifically, the tasks include the quantitation of super-enhancer-mediated gene gating to nuclear pores for gene regulation in different stages of adipocyte differentiation in vitro and ex vivo, in patient-derived tissues. We are looking for a candidate with extensive hands-on training on in situ and bulk assays designed to quantitate 3D chromatin states, gene expression variation, epigenomics, RNA biology and experience in work with small input material. The applicant will join a team with long-standing experience in investigating the role of nuclear architecture and chromatin organization in development and disease, while other research groups in the department are working on translational biomedical research focusing on Alzheimer´s, obesity, bioinformatics and molecular biology-based cancer research, with a focus on precision medicine.

 
Project description
The project is part of a newly established K.G. Jebsen Center for obesity research (CORA, https://stiftkgj.no/en/senter/k-g-jebsen-center-for-obesity_research/), which aims at i) understanding the biological mechanisms underlying weight regain after weight loss, ii) identifying individuals at risk, and iii) developing strategies for sustained weight loss and long-term weight maintenance.

Anita Göndör`s research group is a participant in the center aiming at investigating the role of novel gene regulatory mechanisms that control the expansion of preadipocytes as well as the perturbation of these processes on the path to obesity. In CORA, the group will specifically focus on the role of 3D genome organization in adipose tissue and its role in wight re-gain after weight loss. The candidate will be closely involved in interdisciplinary collaborations with molecular biologists focusing on epigenetic mechanisms in obesity and clinical environments in Norway and abroad.
